userStories.title: Add pre-flight subtitle availability check using --list-subs
acceptanceCriteria: Add list_available_subtitles(video_id) method to CaptionFetcher that runs yt-dlp --list-subs --skip-download
Parse the output to detect available manual and auto-generated subtitle tracks
Return a structured result with available_manual_languages, available_auto_languages, has_any_subtitles
Integrate check into fetch_captions() to fail fast when no subtitles exist before trying formats
Add unit test verifying pre-flight check prevents unnecessary format attempts
userStories.notes: Tier 1 (core functionality). IMPLEMENTED: Added SubtitleAvailabilityResult dataclass and list_available_subtitles() method to CaptionFetcher. The method wraps list_available_languages() and returns structured result with available_manual_languages, available_auto_languages, has_any_subtitles. Pre-flight check was already integrated into _fetch_subtitle() at line 4246. Added 5 unit tests in tests/test_caption_preflight.py covering all acceptance criteria. All 12 tests pass.

userStories.title: Remove duplicate json3 format retry in fallback sequence
acceptanceCriteria: Identify the format fallback sequence in _fetch_subtitle or equivalent method
Remove the duplicate json3 entry that causes redundant retry after json3 already failed
Update the fallback sequence to be json3->vtt->srt (no repeat)
Add auto-generated caption fallback (--write-auto-sub) as final option when manual captions unavailable

userStories.notes: PRE-IMPLEMENTED: All criteria verified. (1) Format fallback in _fetch_subtitle_formats at line 4430 in caption_fetcher.py. (2) _preferred_formats=['json3','vtt','srt'] has no duplicates (line 2361). (3) Sequence verified by TestFormatOnlyTriedOnce tests. (4) Auto-generated fallback in _fetch_subtitle at lines 4407-4419. (5) TestFormatOnlyTriedOnce class in tests/test_caption_format_unavailable.py has 5 tests verifying format uniqueness. All 5 tests pass.
